## Computations

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: "Revenue by day"
#| output: asis
library(dplyr)
orders <- read.csv("orders.csv")
paid <- orders |> filter(status == "paid")
cat("Rows:", nrow(paid), "\n")
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Daily revenue"
#| fig-width: 6
#| code-fold: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.plot([1, 2, 3], [120.5, 98.0, 143.2])
plt.title("Daily revenue")
plt.show()
```

```{julia}
#| label: julia-cell
using Statistics
mean([120.5, 98.0, 143.2])
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.lineY([1, 2, 3]).plot()
```

```{bash}
#| eval: false
ls -la
```
